body.x: AI start-up NuviLab held a CES 2023 Participation Results Briefing Session on Thursday, January 19, sharing the outcome of its participation in CES 2023, the world's largest consumer electronics and IT exhibition. CES 2023 was held in Las Vegas, USA for four days from Thursday, January 5 to Sunday, January 8 in local time.

During the event, NuviLab set up a booth about 132 ㎡ in size, the largest among Korean start-ups, where it showcased its AI, held product demonstrations, and introduced new services. According to a company representative, NuviLab attracted so much attention that thousands of its brochures were gone in just one day.

During the exhibition, NuviLab presented its key solution “AI Food Scanner” along with digital healthcare concept solutions such as an infant growth management solution, diet management solution for people with chronic conditions, mobile food diaries, and food scanning API. They also showcased various solutions to help restaurants reduce food waste in kitchens and serving halls. In particular, NuviLab is also known to have received a good deal of attention and requests for partnership from key industries such as global catering businesses, airlines, hotels, and hospitals, as well as investors.

The government and politicians also showed keen interest. Young Lee, minister of the Ministry of SMEs and Start-ups, Tae-Seog Oh, vice minister of the Ministry of Science and ICT, Joon Pyo Hong, mayor of Daegu Metropolitan City, and Gi-Jeong Kang, mayor of Gwangju Metropolitan City, also visited NuviLab's booth.

(clockwise from the top left) Joon Pyo Hong, mayor of Daegu Metropolitan City; Young Lee, minister of the Ministry of SMEs and Start-ups; Gwan-Seok Yoon, chairperson of the Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs, and Start-ups Committee; Gi-Jeong Gang, mayor of Gwangju Metropolitan City │Photo provided by NuviLab

body.x: Representatives of the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs, and Start-ups Committee (chairman Gwan-Seok Yoon, and Gi-Heon Song, member of the National Assembly), and representatives of the Science, ICT, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee (administrative staff member Seong-Jung Park, and members of the National Assembly Eun-a Heo, Hoon-sik Kang, and Byeong-Wook Kim) participated in the product demonstration themselves, showing interest in the infant model for children's dietary habit care and nutritional component analysis in daycare centers and kindergartens. In addition, Young-sang Ryu, the CEO of SK Telecom, and Dong-Seop Yoon, the president of the Korean Hospital Association, also attended NuviLab's presentation at its booth for over 10 minutes.

“It was a great opportunity to show how we can realize the two key areas of CES 2023: healthcare and sustainability,” said NuviLab’s CEO Dae-hoon Kim. Kim added “We will accelerate advancement into the global market by working with potential customers such as global catering companies, airlines, hotel businesses and hospitals that we met at CES.”

NuviLab has been attracting a lot of attention at home and abroad, thanks to its technology that identifies the types and quantities of food with a single scan to innovate group meal environments. More than 70 companies and organizations have adopted the solution so far, reducing food waste by more than 15 million kilograms in total. Last October, the business received Series A financing from investors such as Smilegate Investment, securing more than 10 billion KRW (about USD 8 million) in cumulated investment.

body.x: CES, the world's largest IT fair, is an exhibition that provides a comprehensive view of the global consumer electronics industry in one place. It is held annually in Las Vegas in January by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News has annually reported on CES news for the world for 17 consecutive years since 2006, hosting the Best of CES, which selects the best innovative products and technologies, and the Best of Made in Korea, which chooses the most innovative businesses in South Korea. In addition, the media has delivered breaking news about CES through AVING LIVE.
